column1: # The English for the enemy status lines -- the four hints under an enemy's
# stats in battle. Hand-written; this is the file to edit.
# Keyed by the Japanese rather than by string slot, because the slot numbers
# belong to one build of one version of the game and the text does not, and
# because a line the game reuses is then translated once rather than once per
# enemy. scripts/extract_enemy_info.js writes the Japanese side, in
# enemy_info_lines.v1.04.tsv; a line left out here stays Japanese in game.
# The panel fits about twenty full-width characters per line and does not wrap,
# so the build measures each of these and says which ones overhang.
# Terms follow the ones already in archives/Rance10EX_v1_04: 異常 is a Debuff, 支援 a
# Buff, 遠隔 Ranged, コンボ a Combo, 大技 a Special Move. 敵 in these lines is
# the enemy the panel is describing, so it reads as "it"; 自軍 is your side.
